remarks: Enjoy bright and airy morning sunrises from this stunning 14th-floor, 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo, offering over 800 sqft of luxurious living space with wall-to-wall windows showcasing panoramic views of the city and Long Island Sound. The open floor plan is ideal for modern living and entertaining, featuring a stylish kitchen with modern cabinets, stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a breakfast bar. The condo boasts wide plank engineered flooring throughout, freshly painted walls, recessed and track lighting, and a custom built-in entertainment storage system. The spacious bedroom has a custom walk-in closet and office area, while the updated bathroom features a walk-in shower, new vanity and an in-unit washer/dryer combo for added convenience. Located in The Biltmore, a premier high-rise condominium, residents enjoy a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, shuttle service to the train, community room, laundry facilities, storage, 4th-flr courtyard, dry cleaning, and a pet-friendly environment. Secure garage parking is available for $115/mo per car. Conveniently located near I-95, Metro-North, Merritt Parkway, and just steps from the vibrant Bedford Street and Pickleball America, one of the largest indoor pickleball venues in the US, this condo offers the best of city living with this exceptional turnkey opportunity in the heart of Stamford!
